action_args.justification: The series has strong trend and seasonality with moderate ranking stability (Kendall tau 0.306) and only 3 validation windows, making fitted weights high-variance. The mean over the 9 most consistently-ranked models (pool3) already captures the benefit of excluding the worst-performing and most redundant models while remaining robust to the correlated-error structure (8 groups, 3 independent). The runner-up (median of all 19) is statistically indistinguishable, confirming that no combination variant offers a reliable gain over this simple, stable pooling strategy.
